title: Live-review telemetry bug: peak_r (closed-bar extreme) is never floored at open_r (live price), so open_r > peak_r and giveback reads negative; it mis-prices hold/tighten options and delays new_peak wakes
roadmap_unmapped_reason: live-money review bug fix under the throttle, operator-approved 2026-11-10
note: Manager diagnosis 2026-11-10 ~13:50Z from the ADA review (pkg-3de13868d406447a, bybit_2). The packets on live-review/rows show peak_r 0.3345 constant since 06:01Z. At 13:33Z open_r was 0.6356, giveback -0.3011. /api/bot/positions at 13:46Z: openR 0.3513, peakR 0.3345, givebackR -0.0167. Cause: src/runtime/position_telemetry.py computes open_r from current_price (live), but peak_r from trail_decay.since_entry_peak over CLOSED bars (bar lows for shorts), with no floor at open_r. The reviewer's 'last close 0.1781' was the 12:00Z closed 2h bar, not the live price. Operator popup: 'Fix now + re-review ADA (Recommended)'.
